name: SIM7000
description: SIMCom SIM7000 LTE-M/NB-IoT/GSM modem — SMS (send, receipts, incoming commands), USSD and HTTP POST over GPRS, with retries and recovery

ready.description: true if the modem answers AT

send_sms.description: Send an SMS with a delivery receipt requested; retries (2 s, 5 s) only if refused before sending, never when it may have gone out

check_receipt.description: Delivery receipt for the last SMS: 1 delivered, 0 not yet, -1 failed

http_post.description: HTTP POST a form body over GPRS with up to 3 attempts on failure or 5xx; returns the HTTP status or -1

set_pwrkey.description: Tell the driver which GPIO drives PWRKEY (K) and its polarity; enables power_cycle() and full recovery

reset.description: Soft restart (AT+CFUN=1,1), wait for it and re-apply settings

power_cycle.description: Hard restart via PWRKEY: switch off (if on), then on, then re-apply settings

recover.description: Soft reset if the modem answers, otherwise power-cycle

maintain.description: Call periodically: returns network status and recovers the modem if it is silent or off-network for 3 minutes

network_status.description: 0 not searching, 1 home, 2 searching, 3 denied, 4 unknown, 5 roaming, -1 no answer

signal_dbm.description: Signal strength in dBm (-113..-51), 0 if unknown

voltage.description: Supply voltage at the modem in mV

network_time.description: Network time as Unix seconds (UTC), 0 until the network sends it

ussd.description: Send a USSD code (e.g. a balance check) and return the network's reply text; closes any menu it opens

allow_number.description: Whitelist a number in code (fixed: can't be removed by SMS); up to 6 numbers in total, matched on the last 9 digits

next_sms.description: Read the oldest stored SMS (then deleted from the SIM); false if none

sms_from.description: Sender of the last SMS read by next_sms()

sms_text.description: Text of the last SMS read by next_sms()

sms_allowed.description: true if the last SMS came from a whitelisted number

sms_command.description: First word of the last SMS in upper case, only for whitelisted senders (else empty)

sms_command_is.description: true if the last SMS is a whitelisted command equal to cmd (case-insensitive)

sms_arg_int.description: First number after the command word of the last SMS (e.g. SETID 7 → 7); -1 if none or sender not whitelisted

sms_arg.description: Second word of the last whitelisted SMS (e.g. the number in SETNUM 0771234567)

sms_arg_is.description: true if the second word of the last whitelisted SMS equals word (case-insensitive), e.g. DOOR OFF

load_alert_number.description: Load the alert recipient saved in flash (or use fallback) and allow it to send commands

set_alert_number_from_sms.description: Save the number given in the last whitelisted SMS (SETNUM <number>) as the alert recipient

load_whitelist.description: Load numbers added by SMS (ALLOW) from flash; call once in setup

whitelist_add_from_sms.description: ALLOW <number> from a whitelisted SMS: 1 added, 0 already allowed, -1 bad number, -2 list full

whitelist_remove_from_sms.description: REMOVE <number>: 1 removed, 0 not on the list, -1 bad number, -2 fixed (admin or alert number)

whitelist_text.description: The whitelist as SMS text, e.g. 'Allowed: 0776162283 (fixed), 0775438588'

specs.voltage: 3.0-4.3V module supply (boards with a buck regulator take 5V+)
specs.current: up to ~2 A bursts when transmitting on GSM
specs.baud: 9600 or 115200 depending on the board (check with AT; some are fixed with AT+IPR)

pins.label: V
pins.note: Board supply (feeds the on-board regulator); needs a 2 A source

pins.label: T
pins.note: Modem TX → MCU RX (GPIO16 on ESP32)

pins.label: R
pins.note: Modem RX ← MCU TX (GPIO17 on ESP32)

pins.label: K
pins.note: PWRKEY (optional): pulse low ~1 s to switch the modem on/off

tips: If the network has no LTE-M/NB-IoT, the modem can wait minutes in automatic mode; this driver forces GSM-only (AT+CNMP=13).
Laptop USB power is not enough when it transmits; use a 2 A supply.
A straight ~8 cm wire on the LTE antenna pad's centre pin works for testing; use a proper antenna in an enclosure.

alternatives.name: SIM800L
alternatives.note: 2G-only, cheaper; some boards ship with IMEIs networks reject.
